dedupe_keys.name: danish cosmetics and personal hygiene packaging take back characterisation 2025

description: This dataset characterises 6,503 primary plastic cosmetics and personal-hygiene packages returned through seventy-two Danish retail stores. Technical University of Denmark and collaborators analysed about 270 kilograms of material during March–May 2025, identifying 823 packaging types from 227 brands. Fields cover brand, container and closure design, product type, colour, wet and dry weights, residues and component weights. DTU Data publishes the workbook, CSV tables, store-location list and documentation free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic coverage is the participating Danish take-back network, not a probability sample of all municipal waste. For repeated packaging types, three cleaned examples can supply the mean dry weight used for other samples; this and return-participation bias are limitations. Modellers could estimate collection yields and sorting or recycling capacity in simulations. data-plasticircle-packaging-waste-pilots and platform-openlca are related resources. No package-level values or workbook were downloaded, and the stated totals were not recounted.
